privacyPolicyContent:
Data Collected:
  • Newsletter: email address
  • Orders: name, email address, order content, notes (optional)

Purpose of Data Processing:
  • Sending newsletters and updates about new creations and events
  • Fulfilling orders and managing feedback
Legal Basis: Voluntary consent of the data subject (GDPR Article 6(1)(a))
Data Security: Data is stored encrypted with AES-256 and hashed with SHA-256. Order content is only forwarded to the data controller's password-protected inbox. Unauthorized access is prevented.
Data Retention: Until consent is withdrawn by the data subject
Data Transfer: No personal data is shared with third parties
Data Storage: The application (frontend, backend, and database) runs on a DigitalOcean droplet located in Frankfurt (EU). Data is stored in a password-protected MongoDB database.
Withdrawal of Consent: You can withdraw your consent at any time without justification by contacting the email address provided

Cookies and Log Files: This site uses cookies for essential functionality as well as optional statistical and convenience features (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Sign-In). These optional cookies are only enabled with your explicit consent.
Data processing is conducted in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and Council (GDPR).

Your Rights:
  • Access your personal data
  • Rectification, erasure, restriction of processing
  • Withdraw consent
  • File a complaint with the Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH)
Automated Decision-Making: This website does not use automated decision-making or profiling.

Data Transfers to Third Countries: With your consent, certain data (e.g., IP address, cookies) may be transferred to Google LLC in the United States. Google is certified under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, which ensures lawful data transfers.
Log Files: The server may temporarily store IP addresses, timestamps, and request URLs for technical error logging. These are retained for a limited time strictly for troubleshooting purposes.
Note: Optional cookies and third-party services (e.g., Google Analytics) are only used with your active consent. You can reopen and modify your cookie settings at any time.

introText:
Origami is the Japanese art of paper folding where any shape can be created from a single sheet of paper without cutting.
It is both a challenge and a meditative activity that improves patience, precision, concentration, and dexterity.
What captivated me most was the act of creation itself. For me, origami is a wonderful journey, an Odyssey.
As the paper slowly comes to life before my eyes, step by step – that’s the most exciting part for me.
Join me in an inspiring demonstration where I present some of my creations and introduce you to the magical world of origami!
cookieText: This website uses cookies to ensure basic functionality and to enhance your experience. You can choose to accept or reject non-essential cookies.
